Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients  

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.  

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. India \- Hyderabad
JOB ID: R\-251649 LOCATION: India \- Hyderabad WORK LOCATION TYPE: On Site DATE POSTED: Aug. 04, 2026 CATEGORY: Human Resources
The Senior Manager, Talent and Performance Platforms is responsible for designing, delivering, and continuously evolving the systems, processes, and digital capabilities that enable Amgen's global Talent and Performance strategy. Working in close partnership with Talent Strategy, HR Technology, Digital, HR Business Partners, and other stakeholders, this role translates Talent and Performance philosophy into scalable, technology\-enabled solutions that improve employee experience and drive business outcomes.


While contributing to the evolution of Amgen's Talent and Performance philosophy, this role's primary accountability is the successful design, implementation, optimization, and governance of the systems, platforms, and operating model that bring those strategies to life. This includes identifying opportunities to simplify work, improve user experience, leverage emerging technologies, and responsibly adopt AI\-enabled capabilities that strengthen talent decisions and organizational effectiveness.


The Senior Manager provides strategic leadership for a Talent and Performance team based in India responsible for day\-to\-day execution. This role establishes the product roadmap, drives continuous innovation, ensures operational excellence, and enables the successful delivery of global Talent and Performance programs.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Talent Strategy Enablement**

* Partner with Talent Strategy leaders to translate Talent and Performance philosophies into scalable global processes, technology solutions, and employee experiences.
* Contribute operational, technology, and user experience insights to support the ongoing evolution of Talent and Performance practices.
* Ensure Talent and Performance solutions align with business priorities while delivering a consistent, high\-quality global employee and manager experience.

**Product \& Platform Leadership**

* Serve as the business product owner for Talent and Performance capabilities across Workday, Eightfold, AI\-enabled solutions, and future Talent technologies.
* Develop and maintain the strategic roadmap for Talent and Performance products, balancing business priorities, user needs, technology opportunities, and operational excellence.
* Partner with HR Technology, Digital, and external vendors to design, configure, test, implement, and continuously enhance Talent solutions.
* Identify opportunities to modernize Talent and Performance through automation, artificial intelligence, advanced analytics, and emerging technologies.
* Evaluate new technologies and industry best practices to continuously improve employee experience, manager effectiveness, and organizational outcomes.
* Ensure Talent platforms are scalable, intuitive, secure, and aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

**Global Program Leadership**

* Lead the design, deployment, governance, and continuous improvement of global Talent and Performance processes, including Performance Management, Talent Reviews, Succession Planning, Talent Marketplace, and other strategic Talent capabilities.
* Develop scalable operating models that enable global consistency while supporting evolving business needs.
* Drive cross\-functional initiatives that improve process effectiveness, user adoption, and organizational outcomes.
* Ensure successful execution of global Talent and Performance initiatives through effective planning, governance, risk management, and stakeholder engagement.

**Team Leadership**

* Provide strategic leadership to the India\-based Talent and Performance leadership and team.
* Establish priorities, operating rhythms, and performance expectations that align with enterprise objectives.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, accountability, continuous learning, and operational excellence.
* Coach and develop leaders while building organizational capability to support future business needs.

**Stakeholder Partnership \& Change Leadership**

* Build trusted partnerships across HR Business Partners, Organizational Effectiveness, HR Operations, Talent Acquisition, Learning, HR Technology, Digital, HR Analytics, and business leaders.
* Influence enterprise decisions regarding Talent and Performance products, platforms, and user experience.
* Lead communication, training, and change management efforts that support successful adoption of new capabilities and ways of working.

**Analytics \& Continuous Improvement**

* Define success measures and leverage workforce data to evaluate the effectiveness of Talent and Performance products and programs.
* Partner with HR Analytics to generate actionable insights that inform product enhancements and strategic decisions.
* Use employee feedback, system metrics, operational data, and external benchmarks to drive continuous improvement and innovation.

**Operational Excellence**

* Ensure Talent and Performance processes are scalable, compliant, and operationally efficient.
* Establish governance, documentation, and quality standards that enable sustainable global execution.
* Manage vendor relationships and external partners supporting Talent and Performance technologies and services, as appropriate.

**Strategic Resource Planning Senior Associate**

**Job Summary**

**About Amgen**


Amgen, a leading biotechnology firm since 1980, is committed to innovation and science, transforming discoveries into treatments for serious illnesses and continuously advancing its pipeline of potential new medicines to significantly improve lives.

**About Operations Strategy \& Business Resilience**


Operations Strategy \& Business Resilience (OSBR) is a diverse internal management consulting arm of Operations that serves as trusted advisors to the company’s leaders in transformational and critical matters at the business perimeter. OSBR’s portfolio of work is comprised of Business Resilience and Intelligence (BR\&I), identifies internal and external risks that can lead to business disruption; Drug Substance (DS) and Drug Product (DP) Network Strategy, develops and progresses Amgen’s manufacturing network strategy to meet business goals; Finished Drug Product (FDP) and Integrated Supply Strategy, partners with the FDP manufacturing network, quality, engineering, external supply and global logistics in developing the necessary set of actions to meet the Operation’s strategic business objectives; Commercialization and Transformation, strategizes commercial and pipeline program expertise, leads transformational operations, and drives business for new technologies and processes in collaboration with Process Development and other functions; Strategy Management, Analytics, Business Development (BD), and Governance, fosters innovation by integrating robust operational strategies, business development opportunities, analytics, and governance to enhance decision\-making and achieve operational goals. Given our areas of expertise, OSBR’s first strategic goal is to attract, retain, advance and champion talent to enable a collegial and collaborative team that collectively will deliver the most comprehensive approach to problem\-solving, strategic insights, and value generation.

 **About the Role**


We are seeking a highly motivated individual for the Strategic Resource Planning Senior Associate – Network Analytics role to join Amgen India (AIN). This role will be an integral member of a high\-performing global OSBR team chartered to deliver comprehensive analytics that support unbiased recommendations and value creation for Amgen Operations.


The Senior Associate will focus on analytics execution in support of the Network Strategy team, with emphasis on manufacturing capacity analysis, long\-range scenario modeling, and strategic horizon assessments using OSBR’s Smart Capacity tool. The role will partner primarily with the Manager and global OSBR colleagues to ensure timely delivery of high\-quality analysis using the correct supply requirements, manufacturing capacity parameters, assumptions, and business context.


This individual will be responsible for performing the analysis, validating inputs, documenting assumptions, extracting insights, and translating complex capacity and scenario analysis into clear, executive\-ready communication materials. The role requires strong analytical rigor, structured problem solving, curiosity to deeply understand Amgen’s internal manufacturing network, and the ability to work effectively with global teams across time zones.


Over time, the Senior Associate will develop familiarity with Amgen’s manufacturing network hot spots, capacity utilization methodology, site\-level operating parameters, and opportunities that may inform network investments, rebalancing decisions, externalization opportunities, and other strategic actions.


Because this role works closely with Amgen’s California headquarters, the Senior Associate is expected to maintain flexible working hours that provide meaningful overlap with the California\-based team, typically from approximately 10:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. and 8:00 p.m. to 11:00 p.m.

 **Job Responsibilities**

* Support advancement of Operations strategy through analytics for Amgen’s manufacturing network, with focus on strategic horizon assessments, typically 5\-9 years of experience, across drug substance, drug product, finished drug product, and related network areas.
* Perform capacity analysis and scenario modeling using OSBR’s Smart Capacity tool to evaluate manufacturing capacity utilization, network hot spots, long\-range business needs, and associated trade\-o
* ffs. Own execution of assigned analyses, including data gathering, input validation, model running, output review, assumption documentation, insight generation, and preparation of supporting materials.
* Ensure analyses are accurate, documented, reproducible, and based on approved assumptions, supply requirements, manufacturing capacity parameters, and business context.
* Understand and apply Amgen’s capacity utilization methodology, including how supply requirements, operating assumptions, site parameters, and network constraints inform capacity outlooks.
* Manage and validate complex data inputs, with emphasis on the two key inputs for capacity analysis: supply requirements and capacity parameters from manufacturing sites.
* Extract insights from complex modeling outputs and translate them into clear implications, risks, opportunities, and recommendations for review by the manager and global OSBR team.
* Transform complex analyses into executive\-ready communication materials, including PowerPoint presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and decision\-support materials.
* Partner with the manager, global team members, and overtime manufacturing sites to clarify assumptions, pressure\-test scenarios, identify analytical gaps, and support problem solving related to capacity constraints or network opportunities.

---------------


Are you interested in building high\-performance, globally scalable Financial systems that support Amazon's current and future growth? Do you have a passion for ensuring a positive customer experience? This is the job for you.  

  

Amazon's Finance Technology organization (FinTech) is responsible for building and maintaining the critical finance technology applications that enable new business growth, ensure compliance with financial and tax reporting obligations, and provide deep analysis of Amazon's financial data. This function is of paramount importance to the company, as it underpins Amazon's ability to effectively manage its finances and drive continued expansion.  

  

Amazon Financial Technology Team is looking for a results\-oriented, driven software development engineer, who can help us create the next generation of distributed, scalable financial systems. Our ideal candidate thrives in a fast\-paced environment, enjoys the challenge of highly complex business contexts that are typically being defined in real\-time. We need someone to design and develop services that facilitate global financial transactions worth billions (USD) annually.  

  

This is a unique opportunity to be part of a mission\-critical initiative with significant organizational visibility and impact.  

  

Design Foundational Greenfield Services: You will collaborate with your team to architect and implement the core services that will form the backbone of this new accounting software. Your technical expertise and innovative thinking will be instrumental in ensuring the foundational services are designed with scalability, reliability, and performance in mind for Amazon.  

  

Adopting Latest Technology: You will have the chance to work with the latest technologies, frameworks, and tools to build these foundational services. This includes leveraging advancements in areas such as cloud computing, distributed systems, data processing, and real\-time analytics.  

  

Solving High\-Scale Processing Challenges: This project will involve handling millions of transactions per day, presenting you with the unique challenge of designing and implementing robust, high\-performance solutions that can handle this scale of volume efficiently. You will be challenged to tackle complex problems related to data processing, queuing, and real\-time analytics.  

  

Cross\-Functional and Senior Engineer Collaboration: You will work closely with cross\-functional teams, including product managers, data engineers, and accountants. You will also be working directly with multiple Principal Engineers and presenting your work to Senior Principal Engineers. This experience will give you the opportunities and visibility to help build the required leadership skills to enhance your career.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define high level and low level design for software solutions using the latest AWS technology in a large distributed environment.
* Take the lead on defining and implementing engineering best practices and using data to define and improve operational best practices.
* Help drive the architecture and technology choices for FinTech accounting products.
* Design, develop and deploy medium to large software solutions for Amazon accounting needs.
* Raise the bar on code quality, including security, readability, consistency, maintainability

  

About the team  

At the heart of FinTech's mission is the Financial Close Systems team, which builds and operates the technologies to support accurate internal and external financial reporting . The Close systems team provides capabilities to teams across FGBS orgs including Accounting, Finance, and Tax to effectively report the consolidated financials to external authorities. The work of the Close systems team is absolutely essential to meeting Amazon's critical month end close timelines and maintaining the integrity of the company's financial data.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.description:
**Description**
**Who is USP?**
 The U.S. Pharmacopeial Convention (USP) is an independent scientific organization that collaborates with the world’s leading health and science experts to develop rigorous quality standards for medicines, dietary supplements, and food ingredients. At USP, we believe that scientific excellence is driven by a commitment to fairness, integrity, and global collaboration. This belief is embedded in our core value of Passion for Quality and is demonstrated through the contributions of more than 1,300 professionals across twenty global locations, working to strengthen the supply of safe, high\-quality medicines worldwide.
   

  

 At USP, we value inclusive scientific collaboration and recognize that attracting diverse expertise strengthens our ability to develop trusted public health standards. We foster an organizational culture that supports equitable access to mentorship, professional development, and leadership opportunities. Our partnerships, standards, and research reflect our belief that ensuring broad participation in scientific leadership results in stronger, more impactful outcomes for global health.
   

  

 USP is proud to be an equal employment opportunity employer (EEOE) and is committed to ensuring fair, merit\-based selection processes that enable the best scientific minds—regardless of background—to contribute to advancing public health solutions worldwide. We provide reasonable accommodations to individuals with disabilities and uphold policies that create an inclusive and collaborative work environment.
   

  

**Brief Job Overview**
 As part of the USP Programs, Regions, Operations, and Strategy (PROpS) Division, the Reference Standards Product Manager leads the development and management of the Small Molecules, Complex Generics, and General Chapters portfolio of reference standards. The Product Management function is responsible for overseeing the full product lifecycle (development to discontinuation), understanding key industry trends, applying data\-driven and analytic decision making and making customer\-focused recommendations that drive product portfolio growth. This role is an individual contributor who will be responsible for implementation of projects and processes that enable decisions about new and existing products. Core activities will also include the development of prioritization, forecasting, and financial models that enhance product mix, optimization and overall performance. This is a highly collaborative role that will be expected to work globally across the organization including Science, Operations, Sales, Regions, Pricing, Trade Compliance, and Marketing. As a product manager, this role will drive product strategy, lead cross\-functional teams in planning product roadmaps, discount and promotion strategies and ensure the successful launch and growth of innovative, high\-quality standards and solutions to drive USP’s mission and vision of improving global health.
   

  

**How will YOU create impact here at USP?**
 As part of our mission to advance scientific rigor and public health standards, you will play a vital role in increasing global access to high\-quality medicines through public standards and related programs. USP prioritizes scientific integrity, regulatory excellence, and evidence\-based decision\-making to ensure health systems worldwide can rely on strong, tested, and globally relevant quality standards.
   

  

 Additionally, USP’s People and Culture division, in partnership with the Equity Office, invests in leadership and workforce development to equip all employees with the skills to create high\-performing, inclusive teams. This includes training in equitable management practices and tools to promote engaged, collaborative, and results\-driven work environments.

* Support continuous improvement of forecasting and product performance against key success metrics
* Manage product mix and optimization for selection and discontinuation of products that enhance profitability
* Identify new product opportunities based on customer needs, feedback, and strategic insights
* Work collaboratively with Marketing, Sales, and Regions to launch and monitor feedback and uptake of items
* Maintain and update product roadmaps to meet targeted product pipeline and growth goals.


**Who is USP Looking For?**
 The Successful Candidate Will Have a Demonstrated Understanding Of Our Mission, Commitment To Excellence Through Inclusive And Equitable Behaviors And Practices, Ability To Quickly Build Credibility With Stakeholders, Along With The Following Competencies And Experience
   

  

* Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in business, Marketing or Science fields with a MBA Degree.
* Minimum five (5\) to seven (7\) years of professional experience in Pharmaceutical industry or related field
* At least two (2\) years managing large product portfolios across B2B and/or B2C companies and managing high performance cross\-functional teams.
* Experience with financial analysis, forecasting, data and analytical tools
* Strong quantitative and critical thinking skills with ability to handle complexity and drive data\-driven solutions.
* Ability to develop and present dashboards, templates and business cases supported by strong rationale, customer insights and business growth goals.

**Job Description**
**Job Description and Responsibilities**
 We are looking for a dynamic and experienced Launch Manager to lead strategic product launches across our Generics and Consumer Health portfolio.
   

  

 You will take full ownership of the launch lifecycle, from planning to execution to closure, ensuring that launches are delivered on time, aligned with business decisions, and optimized for value.
   

  

 As the leader of cross\-functional and multicultural launch teams, you will drive collaboration, challenge assumptions across stakeholders.
   

  

 You will navigate complex tasks with your launch teams, proactively seeking out data, and driving solutions without relying on step\-by\-step instructions.
   

  

* Leading cross\-functional launch teams, ensuring alignment and collaboration across all functions.
* Leading scenario planning and development of contingency plans to proactively address potential risks, delays, or shifts in market conditions, ensuring the team is prepared to adapt and respond effectively.
* Identifying the optimal momentum to launch. Creating ambitious and realistic timelines and overseeing the entire launch process.
* Ensuring achievement of business objectives, evaluating the business case/ profitability throughout the launch. Preparing a recommendation for decision making, if there are signs that the objectives may not be met, including coordinating a no launch decision when necessary.
* Ensuring that launch status and launch related information are up to date in internal systems. Maintaining active oversight of all launch\-related information, ensuring data accuracy and reliability.
* Acting as the primary communicator of the launch view, proactively addressing and resolving critical issues.
* Preparing and presenting proposals for launch\-related business decisions to senior management.
* Ensuring timely and accurate reporting of launch progress and escalating issues as per internal guidance and requests.


**Primary Skills (essential)**
* 10 \+ years of experience in the pharmaceutical industry, with experience in the Generics sector and with at least 8 years in launch management or project management.
* Good understanding of European regulatory processes and solid experience in collaborating with finished\-product suppliers (manufacturing partners).
* Experience in leading cross\-functional teams across diverse cultural and organizational contexts.
* Ability to understand the big picture and long\-term while balancing with details and short\-term priorities.
* Strong leadership skills, with the ability to inspire, challenge, and align stakeholders toward shared goals.
* Excellent networking and communication skills.
* Proven ability to manage multiple, simultaneous launch cases/ projects with efficiency and strategic oversight.
* A proactive mindset, a strong sense of ownership, and a willingness to continuously learn and adapt.
* The capability to thrive in complex, cross\-functional, and international environments, navigating ambiguity with confidence and clarity.
* Strong emotional intelligence and the ability to foster a constructive, solution\-oriented team environment.


**About Us**
 Orion Pharma is a globally operating Nordic pharmaceutical company – a builder of well\-being for over a hundred years.
   

  

 We’re home to more than 4,000 Orionees around the world, and we’re proud to be known as a responsible employer and a great place to work. At Orion Pharma, people are truly valued and trusted, encouraged to grow, and supported by a culture where every voice is heard. We appreciate each other, strive for excellence, and build the future.
   

  

 Together we develop, manufacture, and market human and veterinary pharmaceuticals and active pharmaceutical ingredients. Our extensive portfolio includes proprietary and generic medicines as well as consumer health products. The core therapy areas of our pharmaceutical R\&D are oncology and pain. Proprietary products developed by Orion Pharma are used to treat cancer, neurological diseases, respiratory diseases, and more.
   

  

 We offer careers with a clear purpose: empowering people to live their lives to the fullest.

 More about

 and

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

This role focuses on enhancing the end\-user experience, improving service performance, optimizing operational processes, and increasing adoption of modern workplace technologies.
  
  

Leveraging ITIL, Lean Six Sigma (LSS), Continual Service Improvement (CSI), and Digital Employee Experience (DEX) principles, the analyst partners with service owners, engineering teams, operations teams, vendors, and clients to identify opportunities, implement improvements, and measure outcomes. The role requires a strong combination of analytical skills, customer focus, business acumen, and technical understanding of modern workplace services such as Microsoft 365, endpoint management, collaboration platforms, service desk operations, and end\-user computing services.
  
  

The Service Improvement Analyst will lead improvement initiatives across multiple clients and business functions while ensuring service delivery aligns with business objectives, user expectations, and operational excellence standards.

Service Improvement \& Digital Workplace Optimization
  
  

Lead the development and execution of service improvement initiatives across Digital Workplace Services in partnership with Service Excellence Leads, Service Owners, Engineering, and Operations teams.

Create and maintain operational process documentation including: Process maps and flowcharts Standard operating procedures (SOPs) Capacity and utilization studies Time and motion studies Standard work documentation Cycle\-time and workflow analysis
  
Lead process redesign initiatives to improve efficiency, scalability, standardization, and service quality.
  
Coordinate and track improvement activities resulting from Kaizen workshops, problem\-solving sessions, and operational reviews.
  
Implement Lean Six Sigma, ITIL, and Continuous Improvement methodologies to drive measurable outcomes.
  
  

Analytics, Reporting \& Insights
  
  

Define, monitor, and report on key Digital Workplace Services KPIs and SLAs, including: Service Desk performance End\-user experience metrics Incident and request trends Availability and reliability metrics Adoption and utilization metrics Customer satisfaction (CSAT) Employee experience measures
  
Develop dashboards and reporting frameworks that provide actionable insights to stakeholders.
  
Conduct root cause analysis and trend analysis to proactively address recurring service issues.
  
Utilize data\-driven decision\-making to recommend service enhancements and operational improvements.
  
  

Stakeholder Engagement \& Leadership
  
  

Lead cross\-functional service improvement initiatives involving Operations, Engineering, Service Management, Product Teams, Vendors, and Client stakeholders.

Facilitate workshops, process reviews, and continuous improvement sessions with business and technical teams.

* Expected to be an SME in Pega testing and collaborate with multiple teams to ensure effective testing and quality assurance.
* Responsible for planning and executing testing activities across Pega applications and solutions.
* Analyze business and technical requirements and prepare comprehensive test scenarios and test cases.

* Validate Pega workflows, case management, business rules, integrations, data flows, and user interfaces.

Professional \& Technical Skills

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


Crowe is seeking an experienced **ServiceNow Implementation Lead** to design, develop, and implement scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform. This hands\-on role will focus on developing enterprise applications, automating business processes, integrating external systems, and delivering high\-quality solutions that enable clients to maximize the value of the Now Platform. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise with consulting skills and enjoys solving complex business challenges through innovative platform development.

**Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, configure, and maintain scalable solutions on the ServiceNow platform using platform development best practices.
* Develop custom applications, workflows, integrations, and reusable components leveraging JavaScript, Flow Designer, IntegrationHub, Script Includes, Business Rules, Client Scripts, UI Policies, UI Actions, and other platform capabilities.
* Configure and extend ServiceNow applications, including but not limited to ITSM, ITOM, ITAM, HRSD, CSM, SPM, IRM, and custom applications based on client requirements.
* Develop and maintain REST and SOAP integrations with internal and third\-party enterprise systems.
* Design and optimize Service Catalog offerings, workflows, record producers, and self\-service experiences using Employee Center, Service Portal, and UI Builder.
* Build and support Workspace experiences, Next Experience components, and mobile capabilities.
* Design and maintain data models, CMDB structures, and Common Service Data Model (CSDM) relationships where applicable.
* Implement platform security using ACLs, application scoping, roles, and security best practices.
* Collaborate with solution architects and technical leads to develop scalable, maintainable, and upgrade\-friendly platform solutions.
* Translate business requirements into technical designs and implementation plans using Agile methodologies.
* Perform code reviews, troubleshoot complex platform issues, optimize performance, and support testing and deployment activities.
* Utilize source control, update set management, CI/CD pipelines, and DevOps best practices to support application lifecycle management.
* Lead technical discussions, client workshops, and design sessions while providing guidance on ServiceNow platform capabilities and best practices.
* Produce clear technical documentation, development standards, and implementation artifacts.
* Mentor junior developers and contribute to the continuous improvement of development processes and coding standards.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 5\+ years of professional software development or platform engineering experience, hands\-on ServiceNow development experience.
* Experience designing, developing, and implementing enterprise solutions on the ServiceNow platform.
* Strong understanding of ServiceNow architecture, platform capabilities, and application development best practices.
* Experience working within Agile delivery methodologies.
* Excellent analytical, problem\-solving, communication, and consulting skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor’s degree

 More about

 and
 **what we offer** 
 .
   

  

 Wise is building the best way to move and manage money across borders. To make that possible, customers need to be able to join Wise quickly, safely, and confidently.
   

  

 We’re looking for a Principal Product Manager to join our Onboarding \& KYC team in Hyderabad. You’ll own high\-impact product work across APAC, helping Wise build onboarding and verification experiences that are low\-friction for customers and prevent financial crime.

* Use data, customer insight, operational feedback, and regulatory context to prioritise what matters most.
* Help generalise APAC’s strongest onboarding and KYC capabilities so they can be reused by other Wise product teams.
* Staying close to the details: customer journeys, dashboards, service architecture, regulatory interpretations, edge cases, incidents, and operational workflows.


**Qualifications**

* Significant product management experience, ideally in finance/fintech, identity, onboarding, KYC, risk, compliance, fraud, trust \& safety, or another regulated domain.

* Experience launching products across multiple countries or adapting global platforms to local market requirements.
* Experience working with distributed teams across product, engineering, compliance, operations, and regional leadership.


**Location**
 This role is based in Hyderabad, working closely with teams across Singapore, other APAC markets and Wise’s global product and engineering hubs.
   

  

 Additional Information
   

  

 For everyone, everywhere. We're people building money without borders — without judgement or prejudice, too. We believe teams are strongest when they are diverse, equitable and inclusive.

 Inclusive teams help us live our values and make sure every Wiser feels respected, empowered to contribute towards our mission and able to progress in their careers.

**Company Overview**
 Arcesium is a global financial technology firm that solves complex data\-driven challenges faced by some of the world’s most sophisticated financial institutions. We constantly innovate our platform and capabilities to meet tomorrow’s challenges, anticipate the risks our clients encounter, and design advanced solutions to help our clients achieve transformational business outcomes.

Arcesium is at a particularly interesting time in our own growth as we look to leverage our successfully established market position and expand operations in pursuit of strategic new business opportunities.  We are looking for a talented individual contributor to join a cross\-functional product team responsible for integrating the Order \& Portfolio Management System with the broader platform ecosystem and building new O/PMS features, with a focus on seamless trade lifecycle workflows from order creation through to position synchronization, reconciliation, and post\-trade processing.

* Own features from concept to delivery across the trade lifecycle, producing roadmaps and feature specifications through domain deep\-dives and requirements gathering for order workflows, FIX connectivity, allocation logic, and portfolio analytics.

* Partner with engineers, architects, and platform partners to translate specs into product, bridging trading desk workflows and back\-office accounting while coordinating timelines, dependencies, and deliverables across integration workstreams.
* Build comprehensive test cases covering order routing, execution, position synchronization, data mapping, exception handling, and end\-to\-end integration.
* Conduct competitor analysis across the OMS/PMS/EMS landscape.


**What You'll Need**
* 8\+ years in front, middle, and/or back\-office; 4\+ years in product management.
* 2\+ years of direct experience working with OMS and/or PMS platforms, covering order creation, routing, execution, allocation, and settlement.
* Familiarity with how OMS/PMS platforms interact with execution venues, prime brokers, fund administrators, and accounting engines.
* Experience collaborating with engineers in an agile environment.
* Ability to manage multiple workstreams with diligence.
* Graduate degree in software engineering, finance, or a related quantitative field.

jobs.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**


At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well\-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80\-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI\-enabled insights and technology\-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe**  

Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.


In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high\-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.


Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence.


Crowe’s Microsoft Consulting Practice is hiring an **Agentic Business Process Analyst** to help clients rethink how work gets done in the AI era. This is not a traditional business analyst role focused only on documenting requirements, writing user stories, or mapping current\-state processes. This role is for someone who can diagnose business problems, understand root causes, redesign processes, and identify where AI agents, automation, data, and human judgment should come together.


 The ideal candidate is deeply functional, process\-oriented, and comfortable enough with technology to work side by side with engineers, architects, and client IT teams. This person should be able to bridge business and technology, helping clients move from legacy workflows to intelligent, agent\-enabled processes.


 This role also has an internal transformation mandate. The person will help upskill Crowe Consulting teams that may be used to traditional ERP, CRM, or business application delivery. They will help consultants develop a more modern mindset: start with problems, then processes, then technology.

**What you will do**

* Lead discovery sessions with clients to understand business goals, pain points, process breakdowns, data issues, user needs, controls, and operating constraints.
* Map end\-to\-end business processes, including inputs, outputs, roles, systems, decisions, handoffs, exceptions, controls, and performance measures.
* Diagnose root causes across people, process, data, and technology before recommending solutions.
* Identify opportunities for AI assistance, agentic augmentation, workflow orchestration, automation, knowledge retrieval, decision support, and process improvement.
* Partner with technical architects and engineers to translate process opportunities into solution designs, prototypes, functional specifications, user stories, and delivery roadmaps.
* Define business value measures for agentic solutions, such as time saved, cycle time reduction, first\-time\-right rate, SLA performance, adoption, override rate, CSAT, cost per transaction, revenue lift, and compliance improvement.
* Help clients decide where humans should stay in control, where AI should assist, and where agents can safely orchestrate or automate work.
* Support workshops, demos, process redesign sessions, executive presentations, and change management conversations.
* Create reusable playbooks, templates, process models, and training materials to help Crowe teams adopt an agentic business analysis approach.
* Coach Crowe consultants on how to move beyond legacy requirements gathering into diagnostic, value\-led, AI\-enabled transformation work.

**What success looks like**

* You can walk into a messy client process and make sense of it quickly.
* You can separate symptoms from root causes.
* You know when the right answer is process redesign, data cleanup, integration, training, governance, automation, or AI.
* You can help clients and internal teams understand what agents should do, what humans should do, and how to measure whether the new process is better.
* You make technical teams sharper by giving them better process context, and you make business teams more confident by helping them understand what technology can realistically do.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 6\+ years as a Business Analyst, Functional Consultant, or Process Consultant.
* Strong business process mapping and redesign experience.
* Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 and/or Power Platform implementations.
* Ability to facilitate client workshops and engage executive stakeholders.
* Exposure to AI, automation, or agentic transformation initiatives.
* Experience partnering with technical teams to deliver business solutions.
* Consulting or professional services background.
* Leadership or mentoring experience.

**Position Summary**
 Deloitte’s Global Employer Solutions (GES) Client Technology Delivery Team is seeking an experienced business analyst to help deliver Deloitte’s GES technology enabled mobility services to meet Global Client business objectives.
   

  

 You will be part of our product delivery team, supporting several different delivery capabilities. You will work alongside other business analysts, testers, developers and business team members and report directly to the Product Owner.
   

  

 Your main tasks will include performing detailed requirements analysis, documenting processes, performing some user acceptance testing and identifying improvement opportunities.
   

  

**Work you'll do**
 As a Tax Technology Services Consultant II on the Global Employer Solutions Client Technology Delivery Team, you will be responsible for supporting technology\-enabled mobility solutions and business analysis activities across the product delivery lifecycle.
   

  

* Gather, analyze, and document business and functional requirements in partnership with product owners, subject matter specialists, and stakeholders.
* Translate business needs into user stories, acceptance criteria, process flows, and other delivery artifacts for development and testing teams.
* Support requirements management across the delivery lifecycle, including scope changes, test case review, user acceptance testing, rollout support, training, and communications.
* Evaluate existing processes, identify improvement opportunities, and recommend changes to automate and modernize delivery practices.
* Facilitate stakeholder discussions, resolve requirement ambiguity, and communicate findings, priorities, and recommendations to cross\-functional teams.


**The team**
 The Global Employer Solutions Client Technology Delivery Team supports technology\-enabled mobility services designed to help Deloitte deliver solutions aligned to client business objectives. The team works across product, business, and technology functions to translate complex needs into scalable delivery outcomes. Team members collaborate closely with product owners, developers, testers, and business stakeholders to drive quality, consistency, and continuous improvement.
   

  

**Location: Hyderabad**
**Shift Timings: 11 AM to 8 PM / 2 PM to 11 PM**
**Qualifications**
 Required:
   

  

* 3\+ years of experience as a business analyst supporting technology or product delivery initiatives
* Experience with Agile Scrum methodologies
* Experience eliciting, documenting, and managing business requirements through the development lifecycle
* Experience creating process documentation, process flows, user stories, and acceptance criteria
* Experience supporting user acceptance testing and test case review
* Experience working with cross\-functional teams that include product, business, and technology stakeholders


**Preferred:**

 \#CA\-GSD

Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.

Location: Bangaluru (on\-site, hours flexible)  

  

Ayar Labs is shattering AI data bottlenecks by moving data at the speed of light. As pioneers of co\-packaged optics (CPO), we are using light instead of electricity to move data faster, further, and with a fraction of the energy needed to fuel the explosive growth of AI models.  

  

Backed by industry giants like NVIDIA, AMD, Mediatek and Intel and manufactured in partnership with the world’s leading semiconductor ecosystem, Ayar Labs’ co\-packaged optics solution is key to unleashing next\-generation AI scale\-up architectures.  

  

We are seeking an exceptional Firmware Engineer to own the firmware development lifecycle for our groundbreaking products.  

  

In this critical role, you will drive firmware design from inception to customer deployment, ensuring seamless hardware validation and integration. This is a unique opportunity to leverage your expertise in embedded systems, multi\-chip package environments, and high\-speed SerDes to shape the future of optical interconnect.  

  

  

**Essential Functions:**
* Collaborate closely with analog/mixed\-signal, digital, and photonic block designers to develop sophisticated control algorithms for our photonic circuits and establish the micro\-architecture and embedded requirements for our multi\-chip package systems.
* Drive embedded firmware development: Design, develop, and optimize firmware for controlling complex electronic\-photonic chips featuring multiple high\-speed SerDes.
* Provide Technical Leadership: Mentor and guide junior engineers, contributing to their professional growth and development.
* Partner effectively with diverse teams, including hardware, software, validation and systems engineers, to achieve project goals.


  

**Required Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's in Electrical/Computer Engineering or a related field with 12\+ years of relevant industry experience.
* Proven expertise in bare\-metal embedded firmware development, with strong programming skills in C.
* Hands\-on, proactive approach with the ability to thrive in a fast\-paced, dynamic startup environment.
* Experience with various microcontrollers and firmware debugging tools.
* Experience estimating memory and CPU clock rate requirements.
* Proficiency with modern version control workflows (e.g., Git).
* Familiarity with project management tools (JIRA), and CI/CD tools.
* Ability to own architecture and development of firmware modules from scratch.
* Silicon bring\-up experience
* Experience in scripting with high level language like Python.
* Experience with Make\-based build flows.


  

**Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience in embedded firmware development for high\-speed electronics and photonics applications.
* Silicon bring\-up experience for high\-speed SerDes and photonics applications.


  

NOTE TO RECRUITERS:  

Principals only. We are not accepting resumes from recruiters for this position. Remuneration for recruiting activities is only applicable subject to a signed and executed agreement between the parties. Please don’t send candidates to Ayar Labs, and do not contact our managers.

jobs.title: Sr. Product Manager, IN CX Improvements, Amazon Customer Experience Improvement
jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Customer Service (CS) is a large and global organization, obsessed with taking care of our customers and delivering reliably fast, convenient, and helpful support when they need it. Whether customers interact with our self\-serve solutions or CS Associates, we work hard to make sure they have a delightful experience with us, each and every time.  

We are looking for an experienced customer\-obsessed product leader to join us in the India Customer Experience Improvement org within Customer Service. You will be a part of the IN team of product managers, program managers and business analysts who dig deep into customer friction, trace it back to its source, and drive upstream and downstream product and programmatic improvements to improve CX. You and your team will own the roadmap of IN strategic initiatives while also responding to emerging issues that need immediate attention.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

The role requires someone who can use significant expertise and high judgment to distill diverse inputs from large customer segments and stakeholders to set a vision and design the right long\-term solutions. You will spend your time analyzing customer friction data to identify the biggest opportunities and building compelling cases for improvements. This means diving deep into significantly complex problems where defects create friction across multiple parts of the customer journey. You will work across multiple organizations and leadership to influence and achieve consensus on priorities.  

  

You will partner on product and technology solutions within and outside the Amazon Customer Service org to drive high impact innovation and improvements that can transform the service experience we offer to our customers.
  

You will create mechanisms that make defect elimination sustainable. This includes building dashboards and tools that show customer impact, designing processes that catch problems before they reach customers, and establishing metrics that keep everyone focused on goals. You will be regularly working at both tactical and strategic levels to deliver results.
  

  

This is the right role for you if:  

* You can handle significantly complex problems and efforts, with the ability to see both visible and not\-yet\-visible risks.
* You excel at taking complex technical problems and explaining them clearly to drive consensus among stakeholders.
* You can work strategically to determine where resources are best applied while actively working to remove bottlenecks.
* You create scalable mechanisms and best practices while effectively influencing and force multiplying across organizations.
* You have deep customer obsession and can translate that into measurable improvements in customer experience.

  

A day in the life  

* Lead customer experience workstreams by proactively identifying and eliminating sources of friction.
* Create scalable mechanisms to work across cross\-functional teams and drive organizational change.
* Establish data\-driven approaches to detect issues, surface customer pain points and drive upstream action across organizations.
* Understand how AI is reshaping CX product architectures, product development and customer workflows; apply AI to enable faster learning cycles, accelerate development, make better decisions and unlock new forms of innovation
* Influence strategic direction, customer adoption decisions, engineering and business approach (internally and externally if applicable), vendors, partners, and organization priorities.
* Influence senior leaders to prioritize and address systemic customer experience issues through high\-quality analytics and communication.
* Advocate for customers in product, design, and operational decisions across organizations.
* Deliver measurable outcomes aligned with organizational goals.
* Write and present clear narratives to drive alignment and decision\-making.
* Coach and develop high\-performing teams while creating leadership opportunities.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent
* Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
* Experience with end to end product delivery
* Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
* Experience as a product manager or owner
* Experience owning technology products
* Experience with product cycles of 6\+ months
* Experience in product or program management, product marketing, business development or technology

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
* Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Are you a driven Software Development Engineer who wants to have a direct impact on customers and the team? Do you enjoy building flexible, performant and extensible solutions for complex financial and risk problems? As a Software Development Engineer on Amazon Lending, you will lead designing and building systems to support our financial products. In this role you will work closely with a talented team of software engineers, product managers, and UX designers to build financial products. You will accelerate Lending team's expansion by scaling systems to handle increasing workloads. You will simplify the complexities of partner onboarding, product management and risk assessment through analysis and system design.  

  

Amazon Lending is passionate about helping third party sellers on Amazon grow their business. Since inception, we have provided access to capital for small and medium sized businesses.
  

  

We are a fast\-paced development team, using agile methodologies and SOA design patterns. We encourage innovation and expect engineers to take a high level of ownership throughout the software life cycle. We minimize the bureaucracy and focus on giving developers time to develop. Alongside of building new products and services, we are constantly looking to enhance our existing systems by improving performance and refactoring for reuse. There are numerous opportunities to design scalable architectures.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Define, design, and implement multi\-tier distributed software applications.
* Estimate engineering effort, plan implementation, and rollout system changes that meet requirements for functionality, performance, scalability, reliability, and adherence to development goals and principles.
* Must be able to independently design code and test major features, as well as work jointly with other team members to deliver complex changes.
* Must be able to effectively collaborate in a fast paced environment with multiple teams in a large organization (software development, QA, Project/Release Management, Build and Rele

  

A day in the life  

We are a fast\-paced development team, using agile methodologies to deliver incrementally with each two\-week sprint. We build predominantly in java using a blend of server and serverless based architectures. We are a full stack development organization owning internally and externally facing UI stacks as well as multiple services. We invest heavily in automation in both testing and deployment to reduce time to market and scale our operations. We allocate time for learning and experimentation through learning days and hackathons and provide plenty of opportunities to work along\-side senior engineers. We share our knowledge through weekly learning sessions and monthly tech talks. We constantly seek to innovate new approaches to system design and make our applications faster and more flexible by monitoring system performance and prototyping new ideas.  

  

About the team  

We offer a fun, inclusive, environment to work in with a strong team identity and culture, and a clear mission to help small businesses grow and thrive. We encourage innovation and a high level of ownership throughout the software life cycle.**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 3\+ years of non\-internship professional software development experience
* 2\+ years of non\-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
* Experience programming with at least one software programming language
* Bachelor's degree

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. In short, we’re transforming the meetings and events industry through innovative technology that powers the human connection.

If you love to experiment boldly, share your discoveries, and help define best practices for AI\-augmented work, you’ll thrive here. Our team values professionals who thoughtfully integrate AI into their daily work, delivering exceptional results while relying on the human judgment and creativity that drive real innovation.

This is an ideal role for someone looking to grow in product management and gain hands\-on experience with a dynamic team.

* Develop an in\-depth understanding of the business. products, including its goals and challenges, as well as a comprehensive knowledge of the customers and users of the platform. This involves analyzing their needs, behaviors, and pain points to ensure the product aligns with their expectations and delivers meaningful value.
* Contribute in product discovery by identifying customer pain points and market opportunities by conducting user research, gathering feedback, and analyzing data to support product decisions.
* Collaborate regularly with product managers on the future roadmap, brainstorm new ideas, and prioritize features, ensuring the backlog remains healthy, well\-organized, and aligned with business goals.
* Become a subject matter expert in your product domain, possessing in\-depth knowledge and insights that make you the primary point of contact for internal teams seeking guidance and collaboration.
* Develop detailed product specifications that begin by clearly articulating the “why” \- the core purpose and value behind the product, feature, or enhancements. * Write comprehensive user stories with detailed acceptance criteria that address all functional and non\-functional aspects of the product, including security, data compliance, and other essential requirements.
* Work closely with engineering, design (UX/UI), and other stakeholders to ensure smooth product development and delivery. Also, ensure that all stakeholders are aligned with the product strategy and updates.
* Lead end\-to\-end product development process, from concept and design to development, testing, launch and ensuring timely and high\-quality delivery.
* Lead PI (Program Increment) planning and actively participate in key SCRUM ceremonies, including daily standups, backlog refinement, sprint planning, and product demos.

**About the Company:** 




 GoodScore is on a mission to make financial literacy and credit access simple, actionable, and inclusive for over 150 million Indians who are credit\-underserved. From starting personalized credit consulting in 2023 to now, empowering over 5 million users to take control of their credit health, we are one of India’s fastest\-growing credit score \& credit management apps. We are backed by leading VC funds in India, consistently ranked among the top 10 finance apps in the country, and are currently on a 1x to 100x growth journey. We’re building a high\-impact team that shares our vision of transforming how India understands and manages credit—and this is only the beginning. A few resources and highlights that may be helpful for a quick introduction to Goodscore:
 


* Overview of our recent Series A fundraise
* Podcast featuring our founder, Sanchit Bansal, sharing his vision for Goodscore
* High\-ownership culture offering opportunities to build and scale from zero\-to\-one and one\-to\-many
* Technology\-driven product delivering real, measurable impact on users’ financial lives



  





**About the Role:** 




 We’re looking for exceptional Product Managers to lead product development for one of India’s top 10 finance apps, with 30M\+ downloads and a rapidly growing user base. This role sits at the intersection of strategy, execution, and user experience with direct exposure to the founder and leadership team. You will own end\-to\-end product development, right from identifying high\-impact opportunities to driving execution at scale. This is an opportunity for someone looking to operate in a high\-ownership, fast\-paced environment to shape the next phase of our product growth.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Product Strategy and Roadmap Development
 
 : Work directly with the founder to define and articulate the product vision and strategy. Develop and maintain product roadmaps that align with business objectives and market needs.
* Stakeholder Collaboration
 
 : Engage with cross\-functional teams, including engineering, design, marketing, and sales, to gather requirements, prioritize features, and ensure successful product delivery.
* Customer Insights
 
 : Conduct market research and gather customer feedback to understand user needs and pain points. Use this information to drive product improvements and new feature development.
* Documentation
 
 : Create detailed Product Requirement Documents (PRDs) and Business Requirement Documents (BRDs) that communicate product specifications and business needs to the development team.
* Project Management:
 
 Oversee the product development process from conception to launch, ensuring timely delivery and high\-quality outcomes. Monitor progress and adjust plans as necessary to meet project goals.

 : Track and analyze product performance metrics post\-launch to identify areas for improvement and ensure products meet user expectations and business objectives.
* Innovation and Improvement
 
 : Continuously seek opportunities for product enhancements and innovations that will drive growth and improve user satisfaction



  





**Qualifications:** 



* Entrepreneurial mindset with a bias for action and a passion for building and scaling user\-centric products
* Strong analytical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable product decisions
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence cross\-functional teams
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment with a high degree of ownership
* 2\+ year of experience in product management, preferably in a B2C environment, with a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree from a top\-tier institution

**Product Manager – AI\-First Products** 




**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Product Manager who naturally approaches problems with an AI\-first mindset. This does not mean simply using ChatGPT or adding AI features to products. It means consistently asking:
 


* Can AI make Product Managers more productive?

Job Summary
  
Serve as a Consultant specializing in SAP quality management and production planning within the medical devices domain designing inspection and production solutions that support regulatory compliance and operational excellence while collaborating in a hybrid work model to align system capabilities with evolving manufacturing and quality needs.
  
  

Responsibilities
  
Collaborate with business stakeholders in medical devices manufacturing to capture detailed requirements related to quality inspection production planning and compliance needs and translate them into SAP solution designs that are practical and scalable for long term use
  
Configure and optimize SAP quality management inspection functions for production processes so that inspection lots usage decisions and results recording support precise defect tracking and continuous improvement across plants and lines
  
Design and maintain SAP ERP production planning processes that align demand management material availability and capacity constraints to create realistic production plans that reduce delays and waste
  
Document end to end business processes covering inspection during production nonconformance handling and corrective actions so that process owners and auditors can clearly understand the system enabled controls and traceability
  
Coordinate system testing cycles including unit testing integration testing and user acceptance testing for new or changed SAP quality and production planning solutions to ensure that business scenarios and regulatory use cases are thoroughly validated
  
Provide expert support to production planning and quality teams during day to day operations by troubleshooting SAP issues analyzing root causes and proposing sustainable fixes that minimize downtime and data inconsistencies
  
Develop clear and user friendly training materials and conduct targeted training sessions for planners shop floor users and quality personnel so that system adoption improves and manual workarounds are reduced over time
  
Collaborate with cross functional teams including regulatory affairs and quality assurance to design SAP controls and reports that help demonstrate compliance with medical device regulations and internal quality standards during inspections and audits
  
Work with iRCAS process owners to align SAP inspection and production planning data with risk and complaint management activities so that product quality issues can be traced back to manufacturing conditions and process parameters
  
Monitor system performance and data quality in SAP production and quality modules and propose structured improvement initiatives that enhance master data accuracy batch traceability and on time order completion metrics
  
Engage in incident and change management activities by documenting issues preparing change requests estimating effort and coordinating deployments during agreed maintenance windows to keep systems stable for day shift operations
  
Advise stakeholders on best practices for hybrid work collaboration around SAP changes including the use of remote workshops online testing support and digital documentation so that projects can progress efficiently without travel
  
Align daily consulting work with the organizations broader purpose by shaping SAP enabled processes that support safe reliable and traceable medical devices reaching patients and healthcare providers in a timely and compliant manner
  
  

Qualifications
  
Possess five to eight years of hands on consulting or functional experience in SAP quality management inspection in production and SAP ERP production planning with a demonstrated record of delivering improvements for manufacturing clients
  
Demonstrate solid domain experience in medical devices manufacturing processes including clean room production lot based traceability and device history records and show familiarity with how these needs map into SAP transactions and data
  
Apply practical knowledge of iRCAS or similar complaint and risk management frameworks to help integrate SAP production and quality data into end to end issue tracking and corrective action processes in a compliant way
  
Exhibit strong skills in requirement analysis solution documentation and test case design so that SAP changes are clearly understood by technical teams and are verified thoroughly by business users before go live
  
Show the ability to work effectively in a hybrid work model with day shift coverage using remote collaboration tools structured communication and disciplined handover practices to maintain transparency and continuity across teams
  
Communicate clearly with business and technical partners using concise language and active listening so that complex SAP concepts and regulatory needs can be aligned without misunderstanding or unnecessary rework

Amazon.com, Inc. (NASDAQ:AMZN), a Fortune 500 company based in Seattle, opened on the World Wide Web in July 1995 and today offers Earth's Biggest Selection. About the Role  

  

Join the **Data Analytics (DA)** team at **TII** across domains such as **Marketing and Digital, Merchandising, Supply Chain and Logistics, Store Operations, Finance** and more**.** Here you'll collaborate with business leaders to turn data into insights that drive strategic decisions. You’ll be part of a fast\-moving, high\-impact environment focused on leveraging business intelligence and advanced analytics to solve real\-world problems.  

This role combines technical expertise with business understanding to uncover and communicate actionable insights using cutting\-edge statistical and analytical techniques.  

  

Behind one of the world’s best loved brands is a uniquely capable and brilliant team of data scientists, engineers and analysts. The Target Data \& Analytics team creates the tools and data products to sustainably educate and enable our business partners to make great data\-based decisions at Target. We help develop the technology that personalizes the guest experience, from product recommendations to relevant ad content. We’re also the source of the data and analytics behind Target’s Internet of Things (iOT) applications, fraud detection, Supply Chain optimization and demand forecasting. We play a key role in identifying the test\-and\-measure or A/B test opportunities that continuously help Target improve the guest experience, whether they love to shop in stores or at Target.com.


Key Responsibilities:  

 Translate business problems into well\-defined analytical questions and structured  

approaches  

 Support scenario, decision, and action modelling to evaluate business trade\-offs and  

inform recommended actions  

 Partner with Target business stakeholders to understand priorities and roadmaps,  

validate analytical requirements, and present insights and recommendations with clarity  

and impact

Agentic approaches) that enable decision support, forecasting, optimization, and  

automation  

 Apply advanced analytics techniques, including causal, predictive, and prescriptive  

analytics, to drive deeper understanding of business levers and inform optimal actions

based data warehouses; build and maintain reliable data pipelines using Airflow or  

similar orchestration tools  

 Contribute to AI\-driven analytical workflows, defining quality metrics (e.g., accuracy,  

relevance), assessing reliability, and measuring tangible business impact  

 Ensure analytical outputs are accurate, scalable, and aligned with business context  

 Develop strong data storytelling skills to communicate insights and recommendations to  

non\-technical audiences  

 Document analytical methodologies, assumptions, and outputs to support reuse and  

knowledge sharing  

 Adhere to corporate data protection standards and responsible AI practices  

Requirements / About You:  

Experience: Overall 5\-8 years exp and relevant 3\-5 years exp  

Qualification:

1\. Extensive exposure to Structured Query Language (SQL), SQL Optimization and  

DW/BI concepts.

ability to learn additional vendor and proprietary visualizations tools.  

3\. Strong knowledge of structured (i.e. Teradata, Oracle, Hive) and unstructured  

databases including Hadoop Distributed File System (HDFS). Exposure and extensive  

hands\-on work with large data sets.

series models, Classification Techniques, etc. and conceptual understanding of all  

the techniques mentioned above  

6\. Git source code management \& experience working in an agile environment.

8\. Highly self\-motivated with a strong sense of urgency to be able to work both  

independently and in team settings in a fast\-paced environment; capability to  

manage urgency timelines  

9\. Competent and curious to ask questions and learn to fill gaps, desire to teach and  

learn.  

10\. Excellent communication, service orientation and strong relationship building skills  

11\. Experience with Retail, Merchandising, Marketing will be strong addons  

12\. Hands\-on experience leveraging Generative AI (GenAI) and LLM\-based solutions  

(e.g., prompt engineering, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation – RAG) to enhance data  

analysis, automate insight generation, and support business decision\-making  

13\. Ability to integrate AI\-driven tools and AI\-agent workflows into end\-to\-end analytical  

processes, enabling automation, improving productivity, and scaling analytics use  

cases.

**Project Role :** 
 Business Process Designer
   

  

**Project Role Description :** 
 Analyzes, develops, and improves workflows. Identifies inefficiencies in existing processes and proposes solutions to optimize effectiveness. Collaborates with business users to identify and define detailed product requirements and use cases. Design continuous monitoring and feedback collection to help them refine processes over time.

 Hotel and Lodging
   

  

**Good to have skills :** 
 NA
   

  

**Minimum 3 Year(s) Of Experience Is Required**
**Educational Qualification :** 
 15 years full time education
   

  

 Summary:
   

  

 As a Business Process Designer, a typical day involves carefully examining current workflows to uncover areas that can be enhanced for better efficiency. This role requires working closely with various business users to gather detailed insights and define clear product requirements and use cases. Throughout the day, the individual focuses on developing and refining processes, ensuring they align with organizational goals. Additionally, continuous monitoring and feedback mechanisms are designed and implemented to support ongoing improvements, fostering a dynamic environment where processes evolve to meet changing needs effectively.
   

  

 Roles \& Responsibilities:
   

  

 i. Engage with your target stakeholders – build rapport and trust as you prepare them for the upcoming change
   

  

 ii. Primary go\-to\-person for your target stakeholders with the goal to make the change frictionless for them – be their liaison with other subject matter experts / leaders / other teams across the program

* Enable users with the understanding of the relevant tools and processes
* Assist users in timely completion of the required change management tasks
* Review and ensure accuracy and quality of the change tasks
* Triage process and/or system issues and seek additional help promptly
* Monitor \& report the health of the change and escalate when needed
* Analyze repeat questions, issues, learnings, and suggest best practices
* Contribute to continuous improvement of the processes, knowledge \& tools

* Must have:
* Hospitality skills – Hands on / process / functional knowledge by virtue of either having worked at a hotel / hospitality / aviation / travel company or worked on a project in any of such industry sub\-segments – Minimum 2 years
* Collaboration skills – Excellent project management \& coordination skills – demonstrated experience working directly with external \& internal global stakeholders
* Communication skills – Excellent spoken \& written proficiency in English language – demonstrated experience working directly with external \& internal global stakeholders
* Nice to have:
* Experience with any application transformation project as a business analyst / developer / tester / any role
* Should have (any one):
* Data skills – hands\-on experience working on any data skill in migration / transformation related project – Minimum 2 years
* Analysis / Functional skills – relevant, strong, direct working experience with clients as a functional consultant / business analyst / systems analyst – Minimum 2 years
* Change management – experience of directly managing / being deeply engaged in any major business transformation program – Minimum 2 years


 Additional Information:
   

  

* Should have a minimum of overall 4 years of relevant profession experience
* Should have 15 years of full\-time education
